name: Design A: Jinja-generated CesiumJS page inside the Flask app (/globe)
workstream: W13 architecture design A (globe scaffold; research only)
status: Design only. Nothing under payload/, desktop/, tests/, docs/ or requirements.txt was changed. DECISIONS and ROADMAP entries named here are proposals, not written.
summary: Design A serves /globe from the existing Flask app. A Jinja page embeds CesiumJS 1.146.0 from cdnjs with sha384 integrity, plus a 15-item hand-written JavaScript file that only draws and handles browser-only events. Python owns every number, time, freshness state, alert-geometry choice and storm-cell decision. Every route is behind a default-off setting. No pip package is added and no installer changes. Cloud height and 3D storms are later phases gated on numeric checks. Main costs: a CDN dependency in the desktop shell, no offline 3D view, and voxel payload size.

storms_3d_rules: Levels: 33 levels, 0.5 to 19 km, heightAboveSea (MSL) (mrms.json facts, 500-19000 m).

Below ground: Python compares each level's MSL height with the cell's ground elevation from the job's terrain grid. Cells below ground are not drawn and are counted in the legend. Billings ground is 952 m (terrain.json: Terrarium z11-15 within 952 +/- 50 m; 3DEP 951.6 m), so 0.5 km is about 450 m under the ground and 1.0 km about 48 m above it there. A statewide share is unverified.
No terrain grid: the layer is Unavailable ('terrain check missing'). MSL heights are never drawn over an assumed ground without the check.

No data: exactly -99 and -999 (mrms.json; meanings unverified; NSSL table HTTP 503). Both count as 'no radar data': never 0 dBZ and never clear. The label avoids 'no radar coverage' until the codes are verified (mrms.json limits).
Negative valid dBZ (about -0.5 to -6 in the event step; prototype-mrms.json, unreviewed) are real values below threshold: not drawn, and not treated as no data.
Threshold: Python keeps cells at or above 20, 35 or 50 dBZ, inclusive (evaluation-predeclared.json threshold_count_parity), and returns a class index and palette. JS maps index to colour only.
No interpolation: cells are drawn as sampled, with no smoothing across levels, frames or cells. Each frame carries its valid time. A missing 2-min slot is a gap.

Legend (Python text): 'Radar echo strength in dBZ. Not hail size and not damage. Heights are above sea level; cells below the ground are not drawn. Blank is not clear: it can be no radar data, or no echo at that height.'
Vertical exaggeration 1x, 3x or 5x; any factor other than 1 is labelled on screen as stretched, not to scale (prototype globe.js:356-362).

Size: JSON voxels cost 15.25 B each (computed: 59,938 B / 3,931 voxels, prototype fixture). Event step 2025-06-15 23:12:41Z, 33 levels: 619,321 voxels at >=20 dBZ = 9.44 MB; 99,854 at >=35 dBZ = 1.52 MB (computed from prototype-mrms.json event_per_level_33; unreviewed, agrees with mrms.json at three levels). Default >=35 dBZ; >=20 dBZ only in a packed format (JS-15; 3 B per voxel = 1.86 MB, computed, unmeasured).

Product rules from the supervisor's critique: volumes never on property cards; pins never coloured by echo; no storm-motion arrows, arrival times or probability shells; no height encoding for alerts or candidates; no export in phases 1-5 (a later export bakes in legend, times and DISCLAIMER). No demo data on the globe in any phase (AGENTS rule 5).

route_security_tests: Gate: no hw_session cookie gives 403 on /globe, /api/globe/layers, alerts, places, radar and storms, and /static/globe/globe.js; wrong key gives 403; wrong Host gives 400 (pattern: tests/test_updates.py:262-263; launcher.py:159-179).
Whitelist: globe.js and globe.css give 200; ../app.py, app.py and encoded dot-dot variants give 404.
Settings: POST /settings/globe without the cookie gives 403; a value other than 0 or 1 gives 'settings-bad'; unknown names stay 404 (app.py:921-922).

Headers: /globe sends a CSP with script-src 'self' https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com and no 'unsafe-inline'; 'unsafe-eval' only if the browser check proves Cesium needs it (unverified). /api/globe/* send Cache-Control no-store and X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, and no Access-Control-Allow-Origin.
Escaping: a place named '</script><script>' renders as text in /globe and as a plain JSON string in the API; the config block uses tojson.
No leaks: no response carries the data folder path, the session token, or a product URL's query string. File names only (prototype display_path, serve.py:750-755).
Outbound: product URLs must start with https (same rule as the footprint setting, app.py:891); the server fetches only fixed product URLs; no request parameter becomes a URL.
Caps and timeouts: products over 16 MB are refused with 'Data unavailable' (the prototype allowed 64 MB, serve.py:735); every fetch uses the wx.Http timeout.
Malformed product: a voxel outside the grid, a sentinel used as a dBZ value, or no validity mask gives Unavailable with the reason (prototype check_volume, serve.py:795-843).
Disabled path: zero socket connects for /globe and /api/globe/* with the setting off (patched socket.create_connection).
Browser check (dev only): no CSP violation events and no console errors during the draw test.

risks_ranked: 1. Rule 4 creep: the prototype JavaScript holds threshold, geometry and toggle logic (globe.js:64-68, 224-232, 304-327). Control: the 15-item list is the contract; a test fails if globe.js contains dBZ or threshold literals.

2. CDN and WebGL in the desktop shell: pinned and integrity-checked, but not offline. WebGL 2 is unverified on WebView2 and WKWebView; a Windows machine without WebView2 gets MSHTML with no WebGL 2 (webgl-runtime.json backend_table, F3 corrected).
3. MSL heights over flat ground: 0.5 km is about 450 m below Billings ground (terrain.json). Control: below-ground filter; no terrain grid, no drawing.
4. Voxel payload: 9.44 MB per frame at >=20 dBZ, event step (computed). Control: default >=35 dBZ; packed format only through JS-15.

5. Data rights: GOES files say 'Access is restricted to approved users only' while the registry says open (goes-aws.json); attribution needed (NOAA, NASA, USGS); EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless is non-commercial (base-imagery.json); Google 3D Tiles excluded (globe-libs.json).

6. Publish-job hosting: Actions terms limit use to developing and testing (hosting-options.json gh-terms-1, -2); Pages holds 3.5-6.9 days of 2 MB products (1 GB cap). Object storage or a server is needed (R2 $0 at 4.3-8.6 GB; server $3.50-6.49 per month).
7. Freshness: D12 has one limit, and Feed.judge gives unknown keys 3600 s (weather.py:232). Control: CONTRACTS and FRESH_SECONDS entries, plus a failing test for a missing key.
8. CORS: ACAO * was seen on sampled objects only (gibs.json; goes-aws.json; one GIBS and one USGS tile re-checked today). A host without it fails silently; JS-12 is the only signal.
9. -99 and -999 unverified (mrms.json; NSSL table unreadable): a misreading turns no data into an all-clear. Control: 'no radar data' wording only.
10. Parallax: uncorrected cloud tops sit about 3-4 km off for a 2 km top and 20-33 km off for 12-15 km tops (parallax.json; self-test re-run today, 9/9).
11. No browser step in CI (check-app.yml runs the self-test and unittest only), so JS regressions can pass CI. Control: dev browser check and owner sign-off per phase.
12. Cesium's bundled default ion token and whether ion-off makes zero requests are untraced (globe-libs.json).
13. Library churn: VoxelPrimitive is experimental; @cesium/engine exports are deprecated and removed in 1.150 (globe-libs.json; CHANGES 1.146). Control: exact pin and hashes only.
